intent: Clickable action control with appearance × mode (plus an optional flat set) and a fixed set of sizes.
useWhen: Submitting a form or triggering a primary workflow action
Offering a quieter action alongside content (outline, soft, or ghost)
Destructive actions that need explicit danger styling
Toolbar or compact actions with a Lucide icon and a visible label
Icon-only actions when space is tight and ariaLabel names the action
doNotUseWhen: Navigation to another page or site — use Link (inline, standalone or external)
Icon-only without aria-label — icon-only must set ariaLabel
More than one solid-primary button in the same view

draggable.note: Native drag source. Use with onDragStart/onDragEnd, e.g. a chip that drags into a list.

size.note: Kit sizes. md aligns to Cards medium, sm to small, lg to a larger control.

flat.note: Flat set: no elevation. Combine with solid, outline, or soft (ghost is coerced to soft).

iconStart.note: A curated Lucide name (PascalCase or kebab-case) renders instantly; any other Lucide name needs import "agentic-ds-kit/icons-on-demand" once (otherwise it is skipped with a dev warning). Or pass the Lucide component (Plus) or an element.

iconEnd.note: A curated Lucide name (PascalCase or kebab-case) renders instantly; any other Lucide name needs import "agentic-ds-kit/icons-on-demand" once (otherwise it is skipped with a dev warning). Or pass the Lucide component (Plus) or an element.

shortcut.note: Visual key hint after the label, e.g. "⏎", "Esc", "⌘⏎". aria-hidden: wire the key yourself and set aria-keyshortcuts. Ignored when icon-only.

shape.note: pill uses radius-pill. Drawer footers use pill.

requirements: Visible label via children, OR aria-label for icon-only
disabled sets aria-disabled and prevents interaction
Focus ring must be visible on keyboard focus

doNot: Do not invent local Button appearances or modes outside the enums
Do not use raw hex colors in styles
Do not place more than one appearance=solid mode=primary Button in a single view
Do not pass custom SVG markup as icons — use a Lucide name or Lucide component on iconStart/iconEnd
Do not ship icon-only without ariaLabel
snippet:
<Button appearance="solid" mode="primary" size="md">Save changes</Button>
<Button appearance="outline" mode="neutral" iconStart="Plus">Add</Button>
